# The metric families of the Go 1.x exporter (the go-v1.3.2 capture of /metrics) that 2.0 keeps:
# name, type, label names (a histogram without `le`). The Go runtime (go_*) and the scrape
# handler (promhttp_*) families are dropped (README, Q1 and Q15). A counter is listed under its
# sample name, with `_total`; OpenMetrics names the family without it.

process_cpu_seconds_total counter
process_max_fds gauge
process_network_receive_bytes_total counter
process_network_transmit_bytes_total counter
process_open_fds gauge
process_resident_memory_bytes gauge
process_start_time_seconds gauge
process_virtual_memory_bytes gauge
process_virtual_memory_max_bytes gauge
swarm_cluster_nodes_by_state gauge availability,role,status
swarm_container_state gauge container,display_name,exit_code,orchestrator,project,service,stack,state
swarm_exporter_build_info gauge commit,date,version
swarm_exporter_events_dropped_total counter
swarm_exporter_events_reconnects_total counter
swarm_exporter_health gauge
swarm_exporter_last_poll_success_timestamp_seconds gauge
swarm_exporter_last_resync_success_timestamp_seconds gauge
swarm_exporter_poll_duration_seconds histogram
swarm_exporter_poll_errors_total counter
swarm_exporter_poll_rejections_total counter
swarm_exporter_polls_total counter
swarm_exporter_resyncs_total counter result
swarm_service_at_desired gauge display_name,service,service_mode,stack
swarm_service_desired_replicas gauge display_name,service,service_mode,stack
swarm_service_running_replicas gauge display_name,service,service_mode,stack
swarm_service_schedulable_replicas gauge display_name,service,service_mode,stack
swarm_service_update_completed_timestamp_seconds gauge display_name,service,service_mode,stack
swarm_service_update_started_timestamp_seconds gauge display_name,service,service_mode,stack
swarm_service_update_state_info gauge display_name,service,service_mode,stack,state
swarm_task_replicas_state gauge display_name,service,service_mode,stack,state
